verdict_text:
NO

The script drops head 6 (`DROP_HEAD = 6`), but the specification requires removing head 5. This means it keeps rows/columns 640..767 (head 5) and removes rows/columns 768..895 (head 6) instead of keeping 0..639,768..2047 and removing 640..767, violating clauses 1–4 of "Required result." The shape assertions pass (1920×2048 etc.) but the actual retained slice boundaries are wrong, so the output will not match the hidden reference bit-exactly.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
